tools.name: get_parcel_quote
tools.title: Get live US parcel shipping rates

annotations.title: Get live US parcel shipping rates

tools.description: Live shipping rates for one US-domestic parcel across USPS, UPS and FedEx. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated; give exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. Returns up to five purchasable services with the checkout total, the carrier cost beneath it and the SMKlog fee stated separately. Oversized, palletized or crated shipments are priced by a person: clients that declare the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension get a durable task handle (poll it with tasks/get, answers usually take a few business hours); others get a pointer to the human review page. Shipping labels are bought on smklog.com, not through this tool.

product.description: Plain-words item description, e.g. "65 inch flat screen TV in original box"

quantity.description: How many identical parcels ship together. Defaults to 1.

weight_lb.description: Packed weight in pounds. Optional; estimated from the description when omitted.

length_in.description: Packed box length in inches. Supply all three dimensions AND weight_lb to skip the estimate.

outputSchema.description: Live rates for the shipment. Empty rates with mode "freight_manager" means a person prices it.

mode.description: Quote mode; "freight_manager" routes to a human review

package.description: The packed box the rates were computed for

service.description: Service name without the carrier prefix

retail_amount.description: Carrier retail counter price, USD; 0 when not published

delivery_days.description: Business days in transit when the carrier quotes one

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label

annotations.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label

tools.description: Prices the shipment live and returns a payment session for buying the shipping label: the amount, and a handoff URL that opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This tool never charges anything itself — MPP intent "session", not "charge".

quantity.description: How many identical parcels ship together. Defaults to 1.

service.description: Optional service to anchor the amount, e.g. "USPS Ground Advantage". Cheapest when omitted; the human can still pick any service on the page.

outputSchema.description: A payment session, not a charge: the amount and the handoff URL where the human pays.

method.description: Payment rails behind the checkout, e.g. stripe, card

amount.description: Live-quoted checkout total for the anchored service, USD

service.description: The service the amount is anchored to

handoff_url.description: Opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment

identified_product_title.description: What the estimator understood the item to be

note.description: Standing caveats: live quote, human confirms consents and pays

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.title: Track a SMKlog shipment
tools.description: Track a shipment whose shipping label was bought on smklog.com, by carrier tracking number. Returns the current delivery status, the latest scan events and the estimated delivery date when the carrier reports one. Works for SMKlog labels only — it is not a universal tracker for arbitrary USPS, UPS or FedEx numbers.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number from the SMKlog receipt or label page

outputSchema.description: Current delivery status plus the scan timeline, newest first.

estimated_delivery.description: Estimated delivery date when the carrier reports one

events.description: Scan events, newest first, up to eight

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.title: US parcel shipping price index
tools.description: The SMKlog parcel shipping price index: a monthly repriced basket of six common boxes (1 to 20 lb) shipped from Newark, NJ to five US cities, quoted through the same live USPS, UPS and FedEx pipeline that prices real shipments. Returns the cheapest purchasable service per box and lane with every rate behind it, plus basket averages. Reference data for questions like "what does shipping a shoebox cost in the US right now" — reading it spends no quote allowance. For a price on a specific shipment, call get_parcel_quote instead.

month.description: Issue month as YYYY-MM. Omit for the newest published issue.

outputSchema.description: One published issue of the index: the cheapest service per box and lane with every rate behind it.

captured_on.description: The date every price in this issue was captured

origin.description: Origin of every lane, Newark NJ (07102)

basket_average.description: Mean of the cheapest rate across all thirty cells, USD

carrier_wins.description: How many cells each carrier priced cheapest

cells.description: One entry per box and destination

cheapest.description: The lowest-priced purchasable service for this cell

services.description: Every purchasable service for this cell, cheapest first

page.description: The published issue page on smklog.com
